card.name: Ends of exhale and similar words
card.fires_on: The final piece of a longer word split into parts, most strongly 'exhale' (exh+ale, ex+haled) in breathing instructions. Also fires on endings of words like 'preexistent', 'crucifix', 'Duxiu' and 'exorcises'.

modes.label: Exhale
modes.description: The closing piece of 'exhale/exhaled' after the opening 'ex' or 'exh' in breathing descriptions.
modes.example: After holding the breath, exh<<ale>> and continue to breathe normally.

modes.label: Other split-word endings
modes.description: The final piece of other rare words split into parts, such as 'preexistent', 'crucifix' or the name Duxiu.
modes.example: especially when such a condition was pre<<existent>>.
